bias.en: Rebound · reclaimed the 10-day, under the SAR and 200-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 10 日均线，仍低于抛物线 SAR 和 200 日均线

read.en: Bloom Energy jumped 13.0% on Nov 11 to $209.47, trading $199.48–217.85. It is above the 5-day ($185.9) and 10-day ($196.6) and below the 30-day ($231.0), 100-day ($238.4) and 200-day ($223.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8, below zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($219.56), and RSI is 47.8.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月11日大涨 13.0%，收于 $209.47，盘中区间 $199.48–217.85。股价位于 5 日（$185.9）和 10 日均线（$196.6）上方，30 日（$231.0）、100 日（$238.4）和 200 日均线（$223.2）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图接近收拢（临近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$219.56），RSI 为 47.8。

read.en: The rally reclaimed $185.9–189 and the $194.2–199.8 zone (Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows, 10-day, Nov 9 high), now support; the $217.85 high stopped under the SAR. Resistance is $217.9–220.5 (Nov 11 high, SAR, Nov 3 high), then $223.2 (200-day) and $231 (30-day). Support is $196.6–199.8, then $185.9–189 and $168.8. A close above $220.5 would flip the SAR and target $223–231; below $196.6, $186–189.

r.en: Nov 11 high $217.85; Parabolic SAR $219.56; Nov 3 high $220.5

s.en: 5-day average $185.9; Aug 24 low $185.9; Oct 23 low $189, reclaimed
